items.en: You have to go alone.
items.fr: Tu dois y aller seul.

items.en: Anyone who understands what he has to say enunciates it clearly.
items.fr: Qui se comprend bien s'énonce clairement.

items.en: You have to ask her first.
items.fr: Tu dois d'abord lui demander.

items.en: He has to have his blood pressure taken every day.
items.fr: On doit lui prendre sa pression artérielle chaque jour.
items.after: have his blood pressure taken every day.

items.en: To be an astronomer, you have to study, but to be an astrologer, it is sufficient to be a loser and a big liar.
items.fr: Pour être un astronome, on a besoin d'étudier, mais pour être un astrologue, il suffit juste d'être un raté et un grand menteur.
items.after: study, but to be an astrologer, it is sufficient to be a loser and a big liar.

items.en: He has to be more or less the age of retirement.
items.fr: Il doit avoir plus ou moins l'âge de la retraite.
items.after: be more or less the age of retirement.

items.en: We have to return to the ship now.
items.fr: Nous devons retourner au bateau maintenant.

items.en: Her son is a mama's boy. He has to be with her all the time.
items.fr: Son fils est un fils à maman. Il la suit partout.
items.before: Her son is a mama's boy. He
items.after: be with her all the time.

items.en: You have to meet him.
items.fr: Tu dois le rencontrer.

items.en: She has to look after her mother.
items.fr: Il lui faut s'occuper de sa mère.

items.en: Do you have to open the window?
items.fr: Devez-vous ouvrir la fenêtre ?

items.en: He has some things he has to do.
items.fr: Il a des choses à faire.

items.en: You have to stop drinking.
items.fr: Tu dois arrêter de boire.

items.en: It has to be there.
items.fr: Ce doit être là.

items.en: Do you have to stay?
items.fr: Devez-vous rester ?

items.en: He has to check our passports.
items.fr: Il doit vérifier nos passeports.

items.en: All you have to do is follow me.
items.fr: Tout ce que tu as à faire, c'est de me suivre.

items.en: It has to be done in a parodic way.
items.fr: Il faut le faire de façon parodique.
items.after: be done in a parodic way.

items.en: I have to get used to it.
items.fr: Je dois m'y habituer.

items.en: She has to go there herself.
items.fr: Il faut qu'elle y aille elle-même.

items.en: I have to make another call.
items.fr: Je dois passer un autre appel.

items.en: It has to be diluted with water.
items.fr: Il faut le diluer dans l'eau.

items.en: I have to catch my train.
items.fr: Il faut que je prenne mon train.

items.en: He has to be taller than me.
items.fr: Il faut qu'il soit plus grand que moi.
